cristal-den/enforcer-captain.about-back-to-entry: Cool. I had something else to ask you.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.about-enforcers/confusion: Are… are you flirting with me ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.about-enforcers/entry: We keep this town in one piece. We save our peace from outside threats, and more often than not, from our own unruly folks. You know how it is. Police work.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.ask-about: I'd like to learn more about you.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.ask-about-confusion-encourage: What ? No, I… well, unless… you wanted me to, maybe ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.ask-about-confusion-reject: What ? No, I… I mean I want to know more about this place, and what you all do here !
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.meeting: Who are you and what are you doing in my office ? If you're here to file a complaint, you're at the wrong desk. Get back upstairs.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.meeting-hostile: Sheesh, calm down, lady, I'll be on my way.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.meeting-leave: Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you !
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.meeting-polite-continue: Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you !
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-ask-about-herd: That sounds worrying. Who are these ponies ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-report: I've been to the outpost, as ordered.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-report-dead-wolves: Of course. I took care of the wolf problem.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-report-firearms: I've inspected the bodies. They were shot to death.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-report-herd: I found a body from their likely attackers. Their fur were covered in tribal tatoos.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-report-wolves: A pack of wolf moved in. They've been feeding on the scouts.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.outpost-tell-about-herd-destroyed: I wouldn't worry too much about that Golden Herd. They had their butts kicked at Thornhoof. I was there.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.prompt-leave: Nothing, I'll be on my way.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-outpost-accept: I'll get to it right away.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-outpost-ask-pay: I'd like to talk about my paycheck first.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-outpost-leads: Any reason why this could've happened ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-outpost-negociate-pay: I proved myself reliable, and this sounds more dangerous than patrolling with a team. How much of a risk prenium can I expect ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-outpost-postpone: I have other plans. Maybe later.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work-patrol-negociate-pay: And since I'm not a your standard mercenary, I might ask {{patrolWorkIncreasedReward}} caps, wouldn't you agree ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/ask-name: How about you introduce yourself first ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/entry: You look like you can handle yourself. If you can follow orders and stay in line, we'll get along just fine.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/entry-bad-rep:
Oh. Yeah. I heard about you. And you probably know already, but it can't be a good thing for you.
Tell you what. I'm all for second chances. Prove you can be a force of good, fix up your reputation, and come back to see me. Maybe I'll have work for you then.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/entry-good-rep: I've heard about you. Good things, of course. That already puts you ahead of half my crew. But hey. Due process. I'm not going to do you any favor.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/on-reject-introduction: Oh yeah ? This is a fair, orderly trade we do here. We don't need your kind. Buzz off.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/about-pay: You'll make your usual fee. {{outpostWorkReward}} caps.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/accepted: I'll mark the location on your map. Don't waste time. I'll be waiting for your report.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/intro: I have something that might be better suited for somepony like you. One of our outpost hasn't been reporting in a while. I want you to go there, find out what's going on, and report back to me.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/leads: Could be some malfunction with the radio equipment. Could be that bandits overran the place. You should be careful.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/negociate-pay-failure: You're kidding right ? You didn't prove yourself reliable. Consider yourself lucky I'm even giving you a second chance.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/negociate-pay-success: That's fair. I think I can settle for {{outpostWorkIncreasedReward}} caps.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/postponed: That's not the kind of answer I like to hear. ButI guess you're not a soldier, you're just a mercenary. Get out of my office.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/about-heard-destroye: You're pulling my leg ? For real ? Well damn, you're a lot tougher than I gave you credit for. If that's true, then I guess we're safe, and the outpost must've been cleared by mere remnants on the run. Good. We'll still have to be careful, but this is very good news.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/about-herd: It's a bunch of savages from the far East, who recently came into the Crystal Empire. They call themselves the Golden Herd, and they've been wrecking havoc on the eastern bank of the river. We've been spared so far, but it seems like those days are soon to be over.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/conclusion-failure: Well. Thanks for nothing, then. I guess this kind of task was not suited for you. I was wrong. Get out of here, I have paperwork to fill…
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/conclusion-vague: Hm… well, that doesn't tell us much… but as the very least, we know more about the situation. Thanks for your help.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/conclusion-with-herd: Good job. I mean it. I know I look pissed, but I'm not angry at you. It's just that I hoped we wouldn't be confronted with these ponies. Not anytime soon, at least… I'll have to tell the scouts to be extra careful, and prepare for what will come next.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/entry: What are the news from the outpost then ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/on-firearms-used: I see. Doesn't really help us though. There's no shortage of firearms around.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/on-herd-found:
She sighs heavily.

Fuckin Tartarus… so they're this side of the river too. That bit was important, good job finding that out.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/on-wolves-found:
Damn wolves, defiling the bodies of our comrades…

{{outpostOnWolvesFoundFollowup}}

Did you get rid of them wolves, at least ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/on-wolves-found-foll: Can't believe our scouts would get surprised by wolves… especially inside their outpost ! Something else must've happened, and the wolves came to scavenge the meat.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/outpost/report/prompt: Damn. Well, I can't say I was expecting otherwise, but I wanted to hope for something less dramatic. Any idea about who killed them ?
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/about-pay: Since you're an outsider, you'll be paid as a mercenary. The standard fee is {{patrolWorkReward}} caps.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/expectations: Nothing too dangerous, hoepfully. A few packs of savage beasts, which we have to keep away from town, typically. Bandits, if you're lucky.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/intro: Alright. There's a patrol heading out in a couple of minutes. Just the routine sweep. You go with them, you all come back alive, and we'll talk again.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/negociate-pay-failure: As far as I'm concerned, you're a nobody at best. You'll take the standard pay.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/negociate-pay-success: Hm. Yeah. You already made a name for yourself in town. I guess you can.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/report-failure:
So, I heard you ran away on your own ? I trusted you with a simple mission, and you still somehow managed to disappoint. Your carreer is off to quite the start.
It's the last time you ever went on patrol. And you can forget about getting paid, this time. You're lucky I'm short on ponies. But you'll be doing your next jobs on your own, is that clear ? I'm not letting you put anymore of your partners in danger.
cristal-den/enforcer-captain.work/patrol/report-success:
Back from your patrol, huh ? I've been told you did an adequate job.

Take your reward and listen up. I have another job for you. She gives you {{patrolWorkReward}} caps.
